<USER_REQUEST>
Perform a thorough line-by-line quality and spec compliance audit on Callisto's manifest editing and VCS crates:
- crates/callisto-manifests/
- crates/callisto-vcs/

Inspect for:
1. CST format preservation in Cargo.toml (toml_edit) and package.json (serde_json). Check inline table updates, array order preservation, table decor preservation, comment retention.
2. Workspace inheritance handling (workspace.version = true, workspace.dependencies = true, catalog dependencies).
3. Edge cases in Git revwalk, annotated tag peeling vs lightweight tags, detached HEAD Git repositories.
4. Crash-safety in atomic file writes across all manifest operations.

Inspect files directly using view_file and grep_search. Return a technical report listing every confirmed defect with file:line references, root cause, failing scenario, and recommended fix.
</USER_REQUEST>

2: name: bug-hunter-rust
3: description: >-
4:   Trigger this skill when the user asks to perform a bug hunt, code audit, spec verification, or defect search in a Rust codebase or monorepo workspace. Use when checking for discarded CLI arguments, unhandled parameters, silent unwrap_or fallback defaults, graph fixpoint staleness, UTF-8 BOM or CRLF line ending boundary issues, missing atomic disk write flush or sync_all calls, or subprocess parameter option ordering errors. Also activate when the user requests an adversarial audit across safe Rust codebases, Cargo workspace dependencies, or WASM plugins.
5: ---
6: 
7: # Universal Rust Bug-Hunter Skill
8: 
9: <overview>
10: This skill provides a self-contained, outcome-driven framework for auditing Rust codebases across 6 universal hazard taxonomies. It dynamically adapts to any Rust workspace structure (standalone crates, Cargo monorepos, polyglot WASM plugins) and automatically detects available workspace test runners (`cargo nextest`, `cargo test`, `just test`, `moon run :test`).
11: </overview>
12: 
13: ---
14: 
15: <framework_references>
16: Review shared framework standards prior to executing an audit:
17: - [General Debugging Laws](../../../shared/debugging-laws.md)
18: - [Evaluation Report Template](../../../shared/report-template.md)
19: </framework_references>
20: 
21: ---
22: 
23: <hazard_taxonomies>
24: 
25: ### 1. Discarded Data & Unused CLI / Struct Parameters
26: - **Search Heuristic**: `fn\s+\w+.*\b_[a-zA-Z0-9_]+:\s*` or `let _ =`
27: - **Pattern**: Function para
<truncated 757 bytes>
n type signatures but missing enforcement logic in functions. Unhandled enum variants in pattern matches.
36: 
37: ### 4. Silent Fallbacks & Falsified Defaults
38: - **Search Heuristic**: `\.unwrap_or_else\(|\.unwrap_or_default\(|\.unwrap_or\(`
39: - **Pattern**: Catch-all fallbacks hiding missing or malformed data instead of returning explicit `Result::Err`. Swallowed I/O or subprocess errors returning success reports when disk operations fail.
40: 
41: ### 5. Boundary Inputs & Format Edge Cases
42: - **Search Heuristic**: `split\(|lines\(|from_utf8`
43: - **Pattern**: UTF-8 BOM (`\u{FEFF}`) prefixes, CRLF line endings, missing trailing newlines, non-ASCII Unicode strings, empty workspaces, detached HEAD Git states.
44: 
45: ### 6. Crash-Safety & Subprocess Security
46: - **Search Heuristic**: `Command::new\(|runner\.run\(|NamedTempFile|persist\(`
47: - **Pattern**: File I/O missing `.flush()` or `.sync_all()` calls prior to atomic file rename/persists. Subprocess invocations with misplaced `--` option delimiters or bad flag ordering (`fatal: too many arguments`).
48: 
49: </hazard_taxonomies>
50: 
51: ---
52: 
53: <subagent_dispatch_matrix>
54: 
55: | Agent Role | Target Taxonomies | Delegation Scenario |
56: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
57: | **`bug-hunter-scanner-rust`** | Taxonomies 1 & 4 | Delegate to scan workspace for unused CLI flags, discarded parameters, and silent `unwrap_or` defaults. Returns structured candidate signals. |
58: | **`bug-hunter-adversary-rust`** | Taxonomies 2 & 3 | Delegate to trace execution paths end-to-end, disprove candidate signals, and check graph solver fixpoints and spec drift. Returns confirmed findings with failing scenarios. |
59: | **`bug-hunter-remediator-rust`** | Taxonomies 5 & 6 | Delegate to audit boundary inputs, atomic write `.flush()`/`.sync_all()`, write failing regression tests (red), apply fixes, and verify clean test suite execution (green). |
60: 
61: </subagent_dispatch_matrix>
